Preserve the same emerald-green heavy segmented mechanical armor, rich gold dragon ornament, red stern mech face and long black beard, crown, enormous mechanical circular back ring, paired dragon-headed floating wing blades, green transparent chest cockpit with a clearly visible small human Guan Yu pilot inside. NEW SCENE: THE GUARDIAN HOLDS THE SKY ABOVE THE PEOPLE. An immense protective energy canopy spans the entire city and full width of the painting. The wide continuous luminous emerald-gold canopy is a readable boundary between worlds. BELOW it is a warmly sunlit, bright, safe Chinese mountain city with golden rooftops and protected ordinary people in the foreground. A few clearly readable small human figures look up from the warm light; deep city streets remain visibly safe. Hero is colossal compared with buildings and people but leaves enough of the city visible to tell the story. The canopy is huge and shelters everyone below, not a tiny personal bubble. Dramatic low viewpoint from among the protected citizens, balanced story-led wide composition. Maintain visible red face, beard, cockpit pilot, circular ring, gold dragon shoulder armor and dragon wing heads.
The narrative is protection, sacrifice and reassurance, NOT an origin or upgrade sequence. No workshop, no assembly process, no multiple stages. No enemy characters, incoming projectiles, attack beams or missiles. No text, no letters, no numbers, no UI, no card border, no watermark. Full bleed landscape illustration.
